newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish trade mission to visit Ukraine, China.
newsitem.headline: Turkish trade mission to visit Ukraine, China.

text.p: A Turkish trade delegation led by State Minister Ayfer Yilmaz will go to Ukraine and China in September to boost bilateral trade, foreign trade officials said on Monday.

They said two separate delegations, including trade officials as well as textiles, food, ceramics, construction and machinery industrialists, would visit Ukraine on September 2-5 and China September 23-27.
Representatives from 40 Turkish firms are expected to attend the Ukraine trip and about 400 companies to China, they said.
They said the Chinese trip would be the biggest trade mission organised by the government to any nation so far.
They said Turkish and Chinese officials would hold a joint economic commission meeting in Ankara on September 2-3 ahead of the trade mission that would focus mainly on Turkey's textile imports.
Total Turkish imports from China were worth $549 million in 1995, up from $258 million in 1994. Turkey's exports to China are at negligible levels.
Turkey's imports from Ukraine were $856.3 million in 1995, up from $535.7 million, and its exports rose to 198.5 million in 1995 from $76.3 million a year ago.
